description: China Earthquake Networks Center earthquake catalogue (中国地震台网中心) is a database run by China Earthquake Networks Center. The centre publishes an official real-time and historical earthquake catalogue of China and the world with location, magnitude and depth, and news of felt earthquakes. Coverage: China and the world. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as html; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("地震目录") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support earthquake exposure screening for infrastructure in China. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
